title: Mediana
summary: Raleigh names Mediana in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Mediana, according to whom Nebuchadnezzar was changed in figure so that he appeared a beast. Raleigh does not follow that. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book III, Part I, Chapter I, §. XI, sig. 391b–392a
